Body.Content:
What and Why:

Opal (Frontier) is a Computer Use Agent experience for Microsoft 365 enterprise users. Access is admin-governed and depends on usage-based billing setup for Copilot Credits.

Rollout Schedule:

Rollout begins on November 9th, 2026.

Impact on Your Organization:

Who is affected: 

  • Tenant admins and users who will access Opal (Frontier).

Platforms/Services: 

  • Microsoft 365 admin center Copilot settings
  • Copilot Credits usage-based billing controls.

What will happen: 

  • Opal usage requires Copilot Credits with usage-based billing and spending-policy assignment. Users without an assigned spending policy may be unable to access the experience.

Action Required/Recommendations:

Admins should configure usage-based billing, assign spending policies to required users/groups, and review Copilot Credits cost controls in the Microsoft 365 admin center before broad rollout.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
